comment: Kernel Stage 18 ratchet: strict `platform ===` branch sites outside the adapter packages. Count may only decrease (target ~0 as handlers move behind the registry); decreases update this file.
note: 2026-07-06: +1 for the Stage 32 named platform substitution (applyPlatformWording in ai/prompts/builder.ts) — a deliberate wording branch, not platform logic drift. 2026-07-10: +1 for the fast-reply freshness union-read gate in ai/features/index.ts — the union reads dm_message_archive (the OFAPI post-settle store); Fansly has no webhook lane, so the mode read is OnlyFans-only by design. 2026-07-18: +1 for the P1-2 fan-erasure reachability fix (isFanslyRequest in ai/features/index.ts) — Fansly's conversationRef is the canonical groupId not the fan, so the coach-chat / short-fan-summary fanRef gate is Fansly-specific by design. 2026-07-18 (round-3 P1-3): +1 for the ai:feature-smoke --fan CLI guard (cli.ts) — the smoke requires --fan only on Fansly (conversationRef is the groupId there); on OnlyFans the conversation IS the fan id, so the guard mirrors the server's Fansly-only fanRef contract by design. 2026-07-18 (round-4 P1-3): the persisted fan_ref fallback that once shared the isFanslyRequest branch was REMOVED (it poisoned canonical rows by stamping a groupId into fan_ref; legacy rows are already erasure-reachable via the conversation_ref arm). The gate keeps the branch, so the count is unchanged at 52. 2026-07-22: +1 for the link-stats reconcile page filter (ofapi-link-stats-sync.ts) — mirrors the chargebacks reconcile's onlyfans-only fleet selection by design.
